title: 周末去超市

explanations.1: The subject of the sentence, referring to the speaker.
explanations.3: Shows that the action was done together.
explanations.4: Marks completed action: went to the supermarket.
explanations.5: Refers to mother, the subject of the question.
explanations.6: Indicates possession: the entrance of the supermarket.
explanations.7: Asks for the location of the supermarket entrance.
explanations.8: Indicates the location: in front of the home.
explanations.9: Indicates the location: behind the home.
explanations.10: Indicates the location: inside the supermarket.
explanations.11: Number of people in the supermarket.
explanations.13: Asks about the way to go to the left.
explanations.15: Indicates the order: first go left.
explanations.16: Asks what fruit the person wants to eat.
explanations.18: Presents a choice between two options.
explanations.19: Asks for the number of fruits bought.
explanations.21: Number of cups of milk bought.
explanations.22: Measure word for cups of milk.
explanations.23: Refers to the milk, the subject of the sentence.
explanations.24: Indicates location: on top of the refrigerator.
explanations.25: Indicates that the speaker also took a cup of milk.
explanations.26: Indicates an additional action: also bought bread.
explanations.27: Demonstrative pronoun referring to a specific piece of bread.
explanations.28: Demonstrative pronoun referring to the bread in question.
explanations.30: Expresses ability: I can eat a lot.

translation: Today is the weekend. I went to the supermarket with my mother. She asked where the supermarket entrance was, and I said it was in front of the house. The bus stop is behind the house. We got off the bus and walked into the supermarket. There were five people in the supermarket, too many. She asked how to go to the left, and we first went left to buy fruit. She asked, "What do you want to eat? Don't eat apples, or eat bananas?" I said, "I want to eat apples." She bought some fruit: three apples. Then we went to the right and bought two cups of milk. It was on the refrigerator. I also took a cup of milk. Mother also bought that piece of bread. This bread is not expensive. She asked us how much money we spent, and I said we spent ten yuan. After going home, mother made lunch. I can eat a lot. In the afternoon, I was watching TV. In the evening, my mother and I happily watched a movie together. The movie was the best. We are all very happy today. I will come again.
